GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, under pressure turn and dropped out # faced breeze

Away OK. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid out Six Wide @ 250m & boxed on until faded in last 100m. # Steady effort.

Away fairly. Rolled fwd & raced 5th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Four Wide in straight. # Beaten on turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 1 length. 3rd turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping, made contact with another runner. Shied at the winning post and shifted out and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Two Wide inside Leader .5 700m, took Clear lead but Hard Ridden soon after Straightening Up , fought the race out tenaciously but was grabbed on line # claimed on line
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was contacted on the hindquarter by a runner which shifted out when being crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader 1 length. 2nd turn. weakened. Every Chance # pulled up lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed the filly to be lame in its nearhind leg (grade 4/5). Trainer was told that he would be required to provide a veterinary clearance prior to the filly being permitted to race again. Rider was subsequently interviewed and advised that she was not aware of any soundness issues during the race and whilst she said that the filly knuckled on pulling up, it had not displayed any lameness on return to the mounting enclosure. Vet cert received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 5 lengths. well back turn under pressure. battled away # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Soon after the start was contacted by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, battled on one pace # no excuse
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping with rnr. Raced keenly passing the middle stages and made the 750m turn awkwardly and shifted out.
